note: Baseline: the scripted heuristic, no language model. On real files it drafts metrics with the deterministic fallbacks (or uses the answer file's confirmed definitions) and finds changes with the analysis library; it writes no causes from documents (there are none). Each check reads report.json; its expected numbers come from the SQL in `evals/real/answers/`.
